20.t: Working with data: charging by rubbing
q: State the sign of the charge on the rod and on the cloth.
Rod negative; the cloth is positive by the same amount.
Explain, in terms of electrons, how the rod became charged.
Rubbing moved electrons from the cloth onto the rod. Only electrons move; positive charges stay in the atoms.
Describe the pattern and suggest why the charge levels off.
The charge rises quickly, then levels off near -26 nC. The negative rod repels further electrons, and some charge leaks away to the air, so it gains less each stroke.
